name: Southfield
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Southfield, MI: the tree lighting and new Holiday Market with Santa, a petting zoo and ice carving, plus a Hey Lay Lay cocoa event.
lede: Southfield gathers at the Municipal Campus for a tree lighting and a brand new Holiday Market with Santa, a petting zoo, ice carving and s'mores.
celebrates: The City of Southfield holds its annual Tree Lighting at the Municipal Campus, 26000 Evergreen Road, and in 2026 adds a new Holiday Market. The city's event page lists kids' activities, hot chocolate and s'mores, ice carving, a petting zoo, entertainment, food trucks, costumed characters, visits with Santa and photo opportunities. Activities open at 5 pm, the tree is lit from 6 to 6:30 pm and everything stays open until 9 pm. Admission is free. A separate Hey Lay Lai event in Southfield adds hot cocoa and photos with Santa.
lastyear: The city lists its tree lighting as an annual event, and in 2026 describes the Holiday Market as new. In 2025 the city also ran a Soulful Santa Workshop on Saturday, December 13, priced at $10 for residents and $13 for non-residents, according to a local news report on the program. We did not find a host recap of the 2025 tree lighting itself, so this section does not describe one.
facts: The tree lighting takes place at the Southfield Municipal Campus on Evergreen Road, the same campus that houses city hall. The 2026 Holiday Market is described by the city as new this year. Food trucks sell food on site, while admission to the evening is free. The city lists a petting zoo and ice carving among the activities, which is an unusual pairing for a tree lighting.
traditions: The city lights its tree on the Municipal Campus with a short ceremony from 6 to 6:30 pm.
New in 2026, a market with kids' activities, food trucks and entertainment.
Santa and costumed characters pose for photos at the tree lighting.
Hot chocolate and s'mores are on the city's activity list.
A city workshop that ran in December 2025 and may return.
kidfact: The Southfield tree lighting has a petting zoo and ice carving in the same evening.
faq: The city holds an annual tree lighting at the Municipal Campus, and for 2026 it adds a Holiday Market with kids' activities, ice carving, a petting zoo, food trucks, entertainment, costumed characters and visits with Santa. Admission is free and the evening runs until 9 pm.
When is the Southfield tree lighting?

Thursday, December 10, 2026, at the Southfield Municipal Campus. Activities open from 5 to 5:45 pm, the tree lighting ceremony is from 6 to 6:30 pm and all activities stay open from 6:30 to 9 pm, according to the City of Southfield. Santa visits and photo opportunities are part of the evening.
Is the Southfield tree lighting free?

Yes. The city's event page says admission is free and everyone is welcome. Kids' activities, hot chocolate and s'mores, the petting zoo and visits with Santa are listed on the same page. Food trucks have food available for purchase, so bring a little cash or a card for dinner.
Where is the Southfield tree lighting?

At the Southfield Municipal Campus, 26000 Evergreen Road, Southfield, MI 48076. The city page lists activities opening at 5 pm, so families with young children can come early for the kids' activities and the petting zoo before the ceremony starts at 6 pm.
sources: City of Southfield to Host Annual Tree Lighting and New Holiday Market December 10
